description: Three made-up businesses and the facts each one supplies, assembled with data/policy-clause-library.json. Nothing here is a real business, person, address or practice. A fact marked needs_founder_verification keeps its document from being ready to publish until it is confirmed.

business_facts.service_name: the Harbor Light Tennis Club lessons
business_facts.service_description: Harbor Light Tennis Club runs group and private tennis lessons and sells monthly memberships through its website.
business_facts.activity_risks: falls, collisions, overuse injuries, heat illness and being struck by a ball or racket
business_facts.cancel_method: the Cancel membership button in your account
business_facts.refund_statement: A membership month already started is not refunded; cancel before renewal and you keep access to the end of the paid month. A lesson we cancel is credited or refunded.
business_facts.notice_channel: email to the address on your account
business_facts.data_export_statement: On request we send you a copy of your lesson history before your account is closed.
business_facts.data_categories_table:
| Category | Examples |
|---|---|
| Account | name, email, password hash |
| Lessons | bookings, skill level, attendance |
| Payment | the last four card digits and billing country (held by our payment provider) |
business_facts.purposes_list:
- to run your account and bookings
- to bill memberships
- to keep lessons safe
business_facts.subprocessors_table:
| Provider | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Example Payments Inc. | card payments |
| Example Mail Co. | booking emails |
business_facts.retention_statement: We keep account and booking records while your account is open and for three years after it closes.
business_facts.children_statement: Players under 13 are registered by a parent or guardian, who controls the child's data.
business_facts.ai_providers_statement: We do not use AI to process your data.
business_facts.ai_training_statement: We never use your data to train AI models.
business_facts.connected_accounts_statement: We do not connect to accounts you hold elsewhere.

business_facts.service_description: Northwind Notes is a notebook app where teams write, search and share notes, with an assistant that summarises them.
business_facts.refund_statement: Annual plans are refunded in full within 14 days of purchase; monthly plans are not refunded for a month already started.
business_facts.data_export_statement: You can export all of your notes at any time before and for 30 days after you close your account.
business_facts.data_categories_table:
| Category | Examples |
|---|---|
| Account | name, email, workspace |
| Content | the notes you write and upload |
| Usage | pages opened, features used |
business_facts.purposes_list:
- to provide and secure the service
- to bill plans
- to improve search quality
business_facts.subprocessors_table:
| Provider | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Example Cloud Hosting | storage and compute |
| Example Model Provider | note summaries |
| Example Payments Inc. | card payments |
business_facts.retention_statement: We keep your notes until you delete them or close your account, and delete backups within 35 days after that.
business_facts.children_statement: The service is not for people under 16 and we do not knowingly collect their data.
business_facts.ai_providers_statement: Summaries are produced by a third-party model provider that receives only the note text you ask it to summarise.
business_facts.ai_training_statement: Neither we nor our model provider train models on your notes.
business_facts.connected_accounts_statement: If you connect a calendar, we read only the events you choose to attach to a note.
business_facts.legal_bases_statement: contract, legitimate interests and consent where we ask for it
business_facts.arbitration_body: the American Arbitration Association under its consumer rules

business_facts.service_description: Quill Pottery Studio sells handmade pottery and a pay-what-you-want glaze recipe booklet.
business_facts.refund_statement: Pottery that arrives damaged is replaced or refunded; the booklet is not refunded once downloaded.
business_facts.notice_channel: a notice on the shop page
business_facts.data_export_statement: Ask us and we will send you the order history we hold about you.
business_facts.data_categories_table:
| Category | Examples |
|---|---|
| Orders | name, shipping address, items bought |
business_facts.purposes_list: - to ship and support your order
business_facts.subprocessors_table:
| Provider | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Example Payments Inc. | card payments |
| Example Parcel Co. | delivery |
business_facts.retention_statement: We keep order records for seven years for tax reasons.
business_facts.children_statement: The shop is not directed to children.
business_facts.ai_providers_statement: We do not use AI to process your data.
business_facts.ai_training_statement: We never use your data to train AI models.
business_facts.connected_accounts_statement: We do not connect to accounts you hold elsewhere.
